metadata.title: Transformers Meet In-Context Learning: A Universal Approximation Theory
metadata.authors: Gen Li, Yuchen Jiao, Yu Huang, Yuting Wei, Yuxin Chen

nodes.name: In-context learning (ICL) setting
nodes.statement: An ICL prompt is $(\bm{x}_1, y_1, \dots, \bm{x}_N, y_N, \bm{x}_{N+1})$ with $\bm{x}_i \overset{\text{i.i.d.}}{\sim} \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{X}}$, $z_i \overset{\text{i.i.d.}}{\sim} \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{Z}}$, $y_i = f(\bm{x}_i) + z_i$ for some unknown $f \in \mathcal{F}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Defines the in-context learning prompt as N noisy input-output pairs from an unknown task function followed by a query input.

nodes.name: Sub-Gaussian noise model
nodes.statement: Noise $z_i$ is independent zero-mean sub-Gaussian: $\mathbb{E}[z_i]=0$ and $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{e}^{t z_i}] \le \exp(\sigma^2 t^2/2)$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$.

nodes.name: Input matrix $\bm{H}$ for transformer
nodes.statement: $\bm{H} = [\bm{h}_1, \dots, \bm{h}_{N+1}] \in \mathbb{R}^{D\times(N+1)}$ encodes the prompt with $D \ge d$ to allow auxiliary features; columns carry $(\bm{x}_i, 1, y_i, \mathsf{auxiliary}, \widehat{y}_i^{\mathsf{prev}})$.

nodes.name: Self-attention operator $\att$
nodes.statement: $\mathsf{attn}(\bm{H}; \bm{Q}, \bm{K}, \bm{V}) \coloneqq \frac{1}{N}\bm{V}\bm{H}\sigma_{\mathsf{attn}}\big((\bm{Q}\bm{H})^\top \bm{K}\bm{H}\big)$ with $\bm{Q}, \bm{K}, \bm{V} \in \mathbb{R}^{D\times D}$ and activation $\sigma_{\mathsf{attn}}$.

nodes.name: Multi-head attention layer $\Att_{\bm{\Theta}}$
nodes.statement: $\Att_{\bm{\Theta}}(\bm{H}) \coloneqq \bm{H} + \sum_{m=1}^M \att(\bm{H}; \bm{Q}_m, \bm{K}_m, \bm{V}_m)$ with $\bm{\Theta}=\{\bm{Q}_m, \bm{K}_m, \bm{V}_m\}_{m=1}^M$.

nodes.name: Feed-forward (MLP) layer $\MLP_{\bm{\Theta}}$
nodes.statement: $\MLP_{\bm{\Theta}}(\bm{H}) \coloneqq \bm{H} + \bm{U}\sigma_{\ff}(\bm{W}\bm{H})$ with $\bm{U}, \bm{W} \in \mathbb{R}^{D\times D}$ and ReLU $\sigma_{\ff}(x)=x\ind(x>0)$.

nodes.name: Multi-layer transformer $\TF_{\bm{\Theta}}$
nodes.statement: $\bm{H}^{(l)} = \MLP_{\bm{\Theta}_{\ff}^{(l)}}\big(\Att_{\bm{\Theta}_{\att}^{(l)}}(\bm{H}^{(l-1)})\big)$ for $l=1,\dots,L$, with output $\TF_{\bm{\Theta}}(\bm{H}^{(0)}) \coloneqq \bm{H}^{(L)}$ and readout $\widehat{y}_{N+1} = [\bm{H}^{(L)}]_{D, N+1}$.

nodes.name: Barron-style parameter $C_{\mathcal{F}}$
nodes.statement: $C_{\mathcal{F}} \coloneqq \sup_{f \in \mathcal{F}} |f(\bm{0})| + \int_{\bm{\omega}} \|\bm{\omega}\|_2 F^{\mathsf{sup}}(\bm{\omega})\mathrm{d}\bm{\omega} < \infty$, where $F^{\mathsf{sup}}(\bm{\omega}) \coloneqq \sup_{f \in \mathcal{F}} |F_f(\bm{\omega})|$.
nodes.statement_clean: Class-level extension of Barron's Fourier-magnitude norm: supremum of $|f(0)|$ plus the $\ell_1$ norm of the maximum Fourier magnitude of $\nabla f$ over the function class.

nodes.name: $\varepsilon$-cover $\mathcal{N}_{\varepsilon}$ of $\mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{B}$
nodes.statement: A set $\mathcal{N}_{\varepsilon}$ such that for every $(f, \bm{x}) \in \mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{B}$ there is $(\widehat{f}, \widehat{\bm{x}}) \in \mathcal{N}_{\varepsilon}$ with $\|\bm{x}-\widehat{\bm{x}}\|_2 \le \varepsilon$ and $|f(\bm{x})-f(\bm{0})-(\widehat{f}(\widehat{\bm{x}})-\widehat{f}(\bm{0}))| \le C_{\mathcal{F}}\varepsilon$.

nodes.name: Sigmoid-like function $\phi$
nodes.statement: $\phi(z) = (z+\tfrac12)\ind\{z+\tfrac12 > 0\} - (z-\tfrac12)\ind\{z-\tfrac12 > 0\}$, so $\lim_{z\to-\infty}\phi(z)=0$, $\lim_{z\to\infty}\phi(z)=1$, $\phi(0)=\tfrac12$.

nodes.name: Universal feature $\phi_i^{\mathsf{feature}}$
nodes.statement: $\phi_i^{\mathsf{feature}}(\bm{x}) = \phi\big(\tau(\|\bm{\omega}_i\|_2^{-1} \bm{\omega}_i^\top \bm{x} - t_i)\big)$ for $f$-independent samples $(t_i, \bm{\omega}_i)$ drawn from a probability measure $\Lambda$ depending only on $\mathcal{F}$.

nodes.name: Soft-thresholding operator $\mathsf{ST}_{\eta\lambda}$
nodes.statement: $\mathsf{ST}_{\eta\lambda}(z) \coloneqq \mathsf{sign}(z)\max\{|z|-\eta\lambda, 0\}$, applied entrywise; equals the proximal operator of $\eta\lambda\|\cdot\|_1$.

nodes.name: Universal in-context prediction goal
nodes.statement: Design a single transformer that, given the prompt \eqref{eq:prompt-defn}, outputs $\widehat{y}_{N+1}$ with $\mathbb{E}\big[(\widehat{y}_{N+1} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2\big] \approx 0$ universally for every $f \in \mathcal{F}$, without any prompt-specific updates.

nodes.name: Lasso estimator for in-context coefficients
nodes.statement: $\min_{\bm{\rho} \in \mathbb{R}^{n+1}} \ell(\bm{\rho}) \coloneqq \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho})^2 + \lambda \|\bm{\rho}\|_1$ with $\bm{\phi}_i = [\phi_1^{\mathsf{feature}}(\bm{x}_i), \dots, \phi_n^{\mathsf{feature}}(\bm{x}_i), 1]^\top$.

nodes.name: Class of linear functions $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{linear}}$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{linear}} = \{f_{\bm{a},b}(\bm{x}) = \bm{a}^\top \bm{x} + b \mid \|\bm{a}\|_2 \le C_a, |b| \le C_b\}$ has $C_{\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{linear}}} \le C_a + C_b$.

nodes.name: Linear combination of function classes $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{comp}}$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{comp}} = \{g_{\bm{a},b}(\bm{x}) = \langle \bm{a}, \bm{f}(\bm{x}) \rangle + b \mid \|\bm{a}\|_1 \le C_a, |b| \le C_b, f_i \in \mathcal{F}_i\}$ has $C_{\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{comp}}} \le 2 C_a \max_i C_{\mathcal{F}_i} + C_b$.

nodes.name: Two-layer neural network class $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{neural}}$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{neural}} = \{f_\rho(\bm{x}) = \int_{\bm{a}} \rho(\bm{a})\sigma(\bm{a}^\top \bm{x})\mathrm{d}\bm{a} \mid |\rho(\bm{a})| \le \rho_{\max}(\bm{a})\}$ with logistic $\sigma$; satisfies $C_{\mathcal{F}^{\mathsf{neural}}} \le \tfrac{1}{4}\int_{\bm{a}} \rho_{\max}(\bm{a})(\|\bm{a}\|_2 + 2)\mathrm{d}\bm{a}$.

nodes.name: Main universal approximation theorem for ICL
nodes.statement: There exists a transformer with $L$ layers, $M=O(1)$ heads, input dim $D = d+2n+7$, $n \gtrsim \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$ such that for every $f \in \mathcal{F}$ and prompt drawn per \eqref{eq:prompt-defn}, with prob.~$1-O(N^{-10})$: $\mathbb{E}[(\widehat{y}_{N+1} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2] \lesssim \big(\sqrt{\log N / N} + n/L\big)C_{\mathcal{F}}(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma) + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n$.
nodes.statement_clean: A single universal transformer attains vanishing in-context prediction risk on a general Barron-class of tasks.
assumptions: $\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon$ is an $\varepsilon$-cover of $\mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{B}$ with $\varepsilon \lesssim \sqrt{\log N / N} + n/L$
conclusions: Transformer architecture: $L$ layers, $M=O(1)$ heads, $D = d + 2n + 7$ with $n \gtrsim \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$

Prediction-risk bound $\mathbb{E}[(\widehat{y}_{N+1} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2] \lesssim (\sqrt{\log N/N} + n/L)C_{\mathcal{F}}(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma) + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n$ holds with probability $\ge 1 - O(N^{-10})$

nodes.name: Discrete universal-feature representation (Lemma 1)
nodes.statement: For any $\tau > 4$ and $n \ge c_0 \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$, there exist features $\{\phi_i^{\mathsf{feature}}\}_{i=1}^n$ and coefficients $\{\rho_{f,i}^\star\}$ with $|f(\bm{0})| + \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n|\rho_{f,i}^\star| < 4 C_{\mathcal{F}}$ such that $|f(\bm{x}) - f(\bm{0}) - \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n \rho_{f,i}^\star \phi_i^{\mathsf{feature}}(\bm{x})| \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}(\tfrac{1}{\tau} + \tau\varepsilon + \sqrt{\log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n})$.
conclusions: Existence of universal features $\{\phi_i^{\mathsf{feature}}\}_{i=1}^n$ depending only on $\mathcal{F}$ that linearly approximate $f-f(\bm{0})$ with error $\lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}(1/\tau + \tau\varepsilon + \sqrt{\log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n})$

nodes.name: Integral feature-expression lemma (Lemma 2)
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}$, $\|\bm{x}\|_2 \le 1$, and $\tau > 2$: $|f(\bm{x}) - f(\bm{0}) - f^{\mathsf{approx}}(\bm{x})| \le 3 C_{\mathcal{F}} \delta_\tau$, where $f^{\mathsf{approx}}(\bm{x}) = \int_{\bm{\omega}\ne 0}\int_t \rho_f(t,\bm{\omega})\phi(\tau(\|\bm{\omega}\|_2^{-1}\bm{\omega}^\top \bm{x} - t))\Lambda(\mathrm{d}t,\mathrm{d}\bm{\omega})$ and $|\rho_f| \le 3(C_{\mathcal{F}} - \sup_{\tilde f}|\tilde f(\bm{0})|)$.
conclusions: Continuous integral approximation of $f - f(\bm{0})$ by a sigmoid superposition with error $\le 3 C_{\mathcal{F}} \delta_\tau$

nodes.name: Lasso prediction-error / $\ell_1$-norm bound (Lemma 3)
nodes.statement: For $\lambda \ge c_\lambda(\sqrt{\log N/N}\,\sigma + C_{\mathcal{F}}^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2)$ and any $\widehat{\bm{\rho}}$ independent of $\bm{x}_{N+1}$ with $\ell(\widehat{\bm{\rho}}) - \ell(\bm{\rho}^\star) \le \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$: $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \widehat{\bm{\rho}} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2] \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}(C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 + \lambda^{-2}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}^2 + \sigma\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}) + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + \lambda C_{\mathcal{F}} + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$ and $\|\widehat{\bm{\rho}}\|_1 \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}} + \lambda^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$ with probability $\ge 1-O(N^{-10})$.
conclusions: Prediction-risk bound on $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \widehat{\bm{\rho}} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2]$ in terms of $\lambda, \varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}, \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}, \sigma, C_{\mathcal{F}}$

nodes.name: Empirical-vs-population concentration lemma (Lemma 4)
nodes.statement: With prob.~$\ge 1 - O(N^{-11})$, for any $\bm{\rho}$ independent of $\bm{x}_{N+1}$: $\big|\frac{1}{N}\sum_i [(y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho})^2 - z_i^2] - \mathbb{E}[(f(\bm{x}_{N+1}) - \bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho})^2]\big| \lesssim \sqrt{\log N / N}(\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + \|\bm{\rho}-\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1^2 + \sigma(\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}} + \|\bm{\rho}-\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1))$, plus the lower bound $\frac{1}{N}\sum_i[(y_i-\bm{\phi}_i^\top\bm{\rho})^2-(y_i-\bm{\phi}_i^\top\bm{\rho}^\star)^2] \gtrsim -\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 - \sqrt{\log N/N}\sigma\|\bm{\rho}-\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1$.
assumptions: $\bm{\rho} \in \mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ may depend on $\{(\bm{x}_i, y_i)\}_{i\le N}$ but not on $\bm{x}_{N+1}$
conclusions: Empirical loss concentrates on the population prediction error up to $\sqrt{\log N/N}$ slack

nodes.name: Convergence of inexact proximal gradient (Lemma 5)
nodes.statement: Take $T = (L-1)/2$, $\bm{\rho}_0^{\mathsf{proximal}} = \bm{0}$, $\|\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1 \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}$, $\lambda \gtrsim \sqrt{\log N/N}(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma)$, $\eta = 1/(2n)$, and $\|\bm{e}_t\|_1 \le \varepsilon_{\mathsf{approx}} \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}$. Then with prob.~$\ge 1-O(N^{-10})$: $\ell(\bm{\rho}_T^{\mathsf{proximal}}) \le \ell(\bm{\rho}^\star) + \frac{c_1 n C_{\mathcal{F}}^2}{L} + c_1(L+n)\varepsilon_{\mathsf{approx}}(C_{\mathcal{F}} + \sigma + \max_k \|\bm{\rho}_k^{\mathsf{proximal}}\|_1 + \lambda)$.

nodes.name: Transformer-emulates-Lasso construction (Lemma 6)
nodes.statement: There is a transformer with $L$ layers, $M = O(1)$ heads, taking input $\bm{H}^{(0)}$ as in \eqref{eq:H0-input}, whose output component $\bm{\rho}^{(L)}$ equals the inexact proximal-gradient iterate $\bm{\rho}_{(L-1)/2}^{\mathsf{proximal}}$. With prob.~$\ge 1-O(N^{-10})$: $\ell(\bm{\rho}^{(L)}) - \ell(\bm{\rho}^\star) \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}(\sigma+C_{\mathcal{F}}) + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + n C_{\mathcal{F}}^2/L$ and $(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho}^{(L)} - \widehat{y}^{(L)})^2 \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}^2$.
assumptions: Input matrix $\bm{H}^{(0)}$ takes the canonical form of \eqref{eq:H0-input}
conclusions: Constructive existence of an $L$-layer, $O(1)$-head transformer emulating inexact proximal gradient

nodes.name: Inductive bounds on $\|\bm{e}_t\|_1$ and $\|\bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}}\|_1$ (Lemma 7)
nodes.statement: For $\lambda \ge C\sqrt{\log N/N}(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma) + C_{\mathcal{F}}^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2$ and $\tau \ge C N n^2 (L+n)(N+n) C_{\mathcal{F}}$, for all $t \ge 0$: $\|\bm{e}_t\|_1 \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}/((L+n)nN)$ and $\|\bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}}\|_1 \lesssim n\sqrt{N}\, C_{\mathcal{F}}$.
assumptions: $\tau \ge C N n^2 (L+n)(N+n) C_{\mathcal{F}}$ for some large constant $C$

nodes.name: Inexact proximal gradient method for Lasso
nodes.statement: Iterative soft-thresholding scheme that approximately minimizes $\ell(\bm{\rho}) = \frac{1}{N}\sum_i (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho})^2 + \lambda \|\bm{\rho}\|_1$ via $\bm{\rho}_{t+1}^{\mathsf{proximal}} = \mathsf{ST}_{\eta\lambda}\big(\bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}} + \frac{2\eta}{N}\sum_i (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}})\bm{\phi}_i\big) + \bm{e}_{t+1}$.

nodes.name: Universal in-context learning transformer construction
nodes.statement: Multi-layer transformer with input $\bm{H}^{(0)}$ of \eqref{eq:H0-input}: an initial attention layer \textbf{Attn0} and feed-forward layer \textbf{FF0} for initialization, followed by repetitive blocks of two attention + two MLP layers that emulate the inexact proximal-gradient iterations and produce the prediction $\widehat{y}^{(L)}$.
input: Pretrained transformer weights $\bm{\Theta} = \{\bm{\Theta}_{\att}^{(l)}, \bm{\Theta}_{\ff}^{(l)}\}_{l=1}^L$ depending only on $\mathcal{F}$
output: Coefficient block $\bm{\rho}^{(L)} \in \mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ approximating the Lasso solution

nodes.name: Universal-design parameters
nodes.statement: Transformer parameters depend only on $\mathcal{F}$, with no prior knowledge of the specific in-context task; achieving precision $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{pred}}$ requires $D-d \asymp C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \varepsilon_{\mathsf{pred}}^{-1} \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$, $N \gtrsim C_{\mathcal{F}}^2(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma)^2 \varepsilon_{\mathsf{pred}}^{-2}$, $L \gtrsim C_{\mathcal{F}}^3(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma)\varepsilon_{\mathsf{pred}}^{-2}\log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$.

nodes.name: Logarithmic scaling with covering number
nodes.statement: Both the input dimension and depth need only scale logarithmically with the covering number $|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|$ of the function class, which controls model complexity vs.~function-class complexity.

nodes.name: Sigmoid-attention and ReLU choices
nodes.statement: $\sigma_{\att}(x) = \frac{\mathrm{e}^x}{\mathrm{e}^x + 1}$ (logistic), $\sigma_{\ff}(x) = x \ind(x>0)$ (ReLU), each applied entrywise.

nodes.name: Definition of $\bm{\rho}^\star$
nodes.statement: $\bm{\rho}^\star = [\rho^\star_{f,1}/n, \dots, \rho^\star_{f,n}/n, \rho^\star_{f,0}]^\top$ with $\rho^\star_{f,0} = f(\bm{0})$, packing the per-feature coefficients of Lemma~\ref{lem:discrete} together with the bias.

nodes.name: Discretization scale $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}$
nodes.statement: $\tau = 1/\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ and $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}} \coloneqq c_{\mathsf{dis}} C_{\mathcal{F}}\big(\sqrt{\varepsilon} + \sqrt{\log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n}\big)$.

nodes.name: Barron's universal approximation theorem (cited)
nodes.statement: For any function with bounded Fourier-magnitude norm $C_f = \int_{\bm{\omega}} \|\bm{\omega}\|_2 |F_f(\bm{\omega})|\mathrm{d}\bm{\omega} < \infty$, there is a one-hidden-layer network with $n$ sigmoid units approximating $f$ in $L^2$ within error $O(C_f / \sqrt{n})$.
nodes.origin_citation: Barron 1993, Universal approximation bounds for superpositions of a sigmoidal function

nodes.name: Lasso (cited baseline)
nodes.statement: Classical $\ell_1$-regularized least-squares estimator $\arg\min_{\bm{\rho}} \frac{1}{N}\sum_i (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho})^2 + \lambda\|\bm{\rho}\|_1$ used to recover sparse / small-$\ell_1$-norm regression coefficients.
nodes.origin_citation: Tibshirani 1996, Regression shrinkage and selection via the Lasso

nodes.name: Transformer architecture (cited)
nodes.statement: Multi-head self-attention architecture introduced in `Attention is all you need' that captures intricate dependencies between tokens via $\mathsf{softmax}$-based attention coupled with feed-forward sublayers.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (main theorem)
nodes.statement: Combine Lemmas LP464.1, LP464.3, LP464.5, LP464.6 to bound $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho}^{(L)} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2]$, then add the read-out error bound \eqref{eq:approx-haty} to control $(\widehat{y}_{N+1} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2$, picking $\varepsilon \le \sqrt{\log N/N} + n/L$.

nodes.name: Identify $\bm{\rho}^{(L)}$ with an $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$-optimal Lasso iterate
nodes.statement: From LP464.6, $\ell(\bm{\rho}^{(L)}) - \ell(\bm{\rho}^\star) \le \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$ for $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}} \asymp \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}(\sigma+C_{\mathcal{F}}) + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + nC_{\mathcal{F}}^2/L$.

nodes.name: Apply Lasso prediction-error bound (LP464.3)
nodes.statement: Invoking LP464.3 with $\widehat{\bm{\rho}} = \bm{\rho}^{(L)}$ yields $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho}^{(L)} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2] \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}(C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 + \lambda^{-2}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}^2 + \sigma C_{\mathcal{F}}) + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + \lambda C_{\mathcal{F}} + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$.

nodes.name: Bound $\lambda C_{\mathcal{F}}$ via Young's inequality
nodes.statement: Using $\lambda$ from \eqref{eq:lambda} and Young's inequality $(\log N/N)^{1/6} C_{\mathcal{F}}^{2/3} \widehat{\varepsilon}^{2/3} \le \tfrac{1}{3}\sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 + \tfrac{2}{3}\widehat{\varepsilon}$ to get $\lambda C_{\mathcal{F}} \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}(C_{\mathcal{F}}+\sigma) + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2\varepsilon + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n + \widehat{\varepsilon}$.

nodes.name: Bound $\sqrt{\log N/N}\,\lambda^{-2}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}^2$
nodes.statement: Using $\lambda^2 \gtrsim (\log N/N)^{1/3} C_{\mathcal{F}}^{-2/3}\widehat{\varepsilon}^{2/3}$ and $\widehat{\varepsilon} \asymp \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$, conclude $\sqrt{\log N/N}\,\lambda^{-2}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}^2 \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 + \widehat{\varepsilon}$.

nodes.name: Combine read-out error with prediction-risk bound
nodes.statement: Combine the bound $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho}^{(L)} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2] \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}(\sigma+C_{\mathcal{F}}) + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \varepsilon + C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n + nC_{\mathcal{F}}^2/L$ with read-out error $(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \bm{\rho}^{(L)} - \widehat{y}^{(L)})^2 \lesssim \sqrt{\log N/N}\,C_{\mathcal{F}}^2$ via $(a+b)^2 \le 2a^2+2b^2$.

nodes.name: Conclude with $\varepsilon \le \sqrt{\log N/N} + n/L$
nodes.statement: Take $\varepsilon \le \sqrt{\log N/N} + n/L$ to absorb the $C_{\mathcal{F}}^2 \varepsilon$ term and obtain Theorem~\ref{thm:main}.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 1 (discrete features)
nodes.statement: Apply LP464.2 to obtain a continuous integral representation of $f - f(\bm{0})$, then use Hoeffding's inequality plus union bound over $\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon$ to discretize the integral by drawing $n$ i.i.d.~samples $(t_i, \bm{\omega}_i) \sim \Lambda$.

nodes.name: Continuous representation via LP464.2
nodes.statement: Lemma 2 gives $|f(\bm{x})-f(\bm{0}) - f^{\mathsf{approx}}(\bm{x})| \le 3 C_{\mathcal{F}}\delta_\tau$ with $f^{\mathsf{approx}}$ defined as a continuous integral of $\phi(\tau(\cdot))$ over $\Lambda$.

nodes.name: Discretize via $n$ Monte-Carlo samples
nodes.statement: Draw $n$ i.i.d.~$(t_i,\bm{\omega}_i) \sim \Lambda$ and use Hoeffding's inequality with the bound $|\rho_{\widehat f}\,\phi(\cdot)| \le 3\widetilde{C}_{\mathcal{F}}$ to obtain a finite-sum approximation with error $\lesssim \widetilde{C}_{\mathcal{F}}\sqrt{\log|\mathcal{N}_\varepsilon|/n}$.

nodes.name: Union bound over the $\varepsilon$-cover
nodes.statement: Take a union bound over $(\widehat{f}, \widehat{\bm{x}}) \in \mathcal{N}_\varepsilon$ and translate by the $\varepsilon$-cover guarantee to extend the bound to all $(f, \bm{x}) \in \mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{B}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 3 (Lasso prediction bound)
nodes.statement: Use LP464.4 (empirical concentration) and the $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$-optimality of $\widehat{\bm{\rho}}$ to first bound $\|\widehat{\bm{\rho}}\|_1$ by contradiction, then transfer to a prediction-error bound via concentration.

nodes.name: Contradiction setup for $\ell_1$ bound
nodes.statement: Suppose $\|\widehat{\bm{\rho}}\|_1 > 4\|\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1 + C_{\mathcal{F}} + 4\lambda^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$; combine with LP464.4 lower bound to derive $\ell(\widehat{\bm{\rho}}) - \ell(\bm{\rho}^\star) > \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$, contradicting $\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$-optimality.

nodes.name: Conclude $\|\widehat{\bm{\rho}}\|_1 \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}} + \lambda^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$
nodes.statement: Negation gives $\|\widehat{\bm{\rho}}\|_1 \le 4\|\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1 + C_{\mathcal{F}} + 4\lambda^{-1}\varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$, and $\|\bm{\rho}^\star\|_1 \lesssim C_{\mathcal{F}}$ (Lemma 1) yields the claimed asymptotic bound.

nodes.name: Transfer empirical loss to population prediction error
nodes.statement: Apply LP464.4 (concentration) and the upper bound $\frac{1}{N}\sum_i (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \widehat{\bm{\rho}})^2 \le \frac{1}{N}\sum_i z_i^2 + O(\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}}^2 + \sqrt{\log N/N}\sigma\varepsilon_{\mathsf{dis}} + \lambda C_{\mathcal{F}}) + \varepsilon_{\mathsf{opt}}$ to bound $\mathbb{E}[(\bm{\phi}_{N+1}^\top \widehat{\bm{\rho}} - f(\bm{x}_{N+1}))^2]$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 6 (transformer construction)
nodes.statement: Construct an explicit multi-layer transformer (initialization block Attn0/FF0 followed by $L$ repetitive blocks) implementing one inexact proximal-gradient step per block; combine LP464.5 and LP464.7 to bound the optimization gap and the read-out error.

nodes.name: Initialize $\bm{\rho}_0^{\mathsf{proximal}} = \bm{0}$
nodes.statement: Set the initial Lasso iterate to zero.

nodes.name: Inexact proximal-gradient update
nodes.statement: For $t = 0, \dots, T$: $\bm{\rho}_{t+1}^{\mathsf{proximal}} = \mathsf{ST}_{\eta\lambda}\big(\bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}} + \frac{2\eta}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N (y_i - \bm{\phi}_i^\top \bm{\rho}_t^{\mathsf{proximal}})\bm{\phi}_i\big) + \bm{e}_{t+1}$ with $\|\bm{e}_{t+1}\|_1 \le \varepsilon_{\mathsf{approx}}$.

nodes.name: Return final iterate
nodes.statement: Return $\bm{\rho}_T^{\mathsf{proximal}}$ after $T = (L-1)/2$ iterations.

nodes.name: Embed prompt into $\bm{H}^{(0)}$
nodes.statement: Pack $(\bm{x}_i, y_i)$ into the canonical input matrix $\bm{H}^{(0)} \in \mathbb{R}^{(d+2n+7)\times(N+1)}$ as in \eqref{eq:H0-input} with $w_i^{(0)} = 1$ for $i \le N$, $w_{N+1}^{(0)} = 0$, $\bm{\rho}^{(0)} = \bm{0}$, $\lambda^{(0)} = \widehat{y}^{(0)} = 0$.

nodes.name: Initialization block (Attn0 + FF0)
nodes.statement: Apply the dedicated initialization attention layer Attn0 followed by feed-forward layer FF0 to populate the universal-feature rows $\bm{\phi}_i^{(1)}$ from $\bm{x}_i$ and prepare the $\bm{\rho}^{(1)}, \lambda^{(1)}$ slots.

nodes.name: Repeated 2-attention + 2-MLP blocks emulate a proximal-gradient iteration
nodes.statement: Each block of two attention layers and two feed-forward layers implements one inexact proximal-gradient update of \eqref{eq:update-rule-PGD}: residuals are formed by attention, the soft-thresholding step is realized by the MLPs, and the result overwrites $\bm{\rho}^{(l)}$.

nodes.name: Read out prediction $\widehat{y}_{N+1}$
nodes.statement: Output $\widehat{y}_{N+1} = \widehat{y}^{(L)} = [\bm{H}^{(L)}]_{D, N+1}$ from the last entry of the final hidden matrix.
